title: Plumeform answer-type chooser band
description: A near-black green band: bold heading and a long paragraph side by side, then labelled groups of outlined pill chips (one selected in mint) beside a glass demo card with two offset cards stacked behind it, back and next controls and a counter, then the complete list in five columns with tier tags. Rises in as it scrolls; chips brighten on hover.
notes: the demo card is a media slot (the original runs a live example per type); the chips and controls are static
name: plumeform-types

props.name: body
props.description: the long paragraph on the right

props.name: groups
props.description: chips in labelled groups; the first chip of the first group shows as selected

props.name: media
props.description: the demo card (a working example of the selected type); empty shows a placeholder

props.name: aspect
props.description: placeholder size of the demo card, width / height

props.name: controls
props.type: { previousLabel: string; nextLabel: string; counter: string; }

props.name: all

props.description: the complete list, in five columns on desktop

props.name: extra
